build_revisions.reason: Final-v2 after confirmed FLUSH u64::MAX descriptor fix, fatal queue supervision and joined completion-pump teardown; six real clean deletions and short MySQL SIGKILL/integrity diagnostic passed. Also incorporates final engine warm sorting, bounded TRIM and generation shutdown fixes. Earlier 839 screening remains exploratory and failed ublk attempt excluded.
build_revisions.protocol: Prior per-stage binary hashes and raw proofs remain unchanged. Completed screening is exploratory evidence for profile selection; failed stages are retried and remaining qualification uses this revision.

build_revisions.reason: Final-v3 adds physically grouped parallel offline warm. Rust hot paths unchanged from validated 38c94 transport; 92 tests, real io_uring teardown and Clippy passed. Controlled warm sweep 8/16/32/64/128 complete with original caches restored. All qualification uses b39b705; prior screenings remain selection-only. Astra preparation explicitly uses --warm-concurrency 128; legacy preparation remains unchanged. Strict proof/SHA reuse and SQL-error exclusions apply.
build_revisions.protocol: Prior per-stage binary hashes and raw proofs remain unchanged. Completed screening is exploratory evidence for profile selection; failed stages are retried and remaining qualification uses this revision.

final_confirmation.protocol: small fixture, 3 samples of 30s per workload, NBD then ublk; separate engine SIGKILL during mixed writes, ext4 recovery and InnoDB CHECK TABLE; process cgroup v2 CPU counters sampled

cpu_control.protocol: Separate CPU-quota diagnostic, not a replacement for the 1-CPU campaign. Baseline/Astra NBD/native, small mixed then large uniform read-only; same seed, configured caches and warmup durations. Cache banks preserve only disposable cache files; every large InfiniDisk2 stage still runs complete warm.

transport_comparison.protocol: Large uniform read-only with the same selected profile and configured caches as NBD; only ublk_fast_path and transport differ. Quotas 1 and 2 CPU are reported separately from the six CPU-quota stages.

sql_diagnostics.scope: separate fixed diagnostic; no replacement samples; historical events remain individually unidentified
sql_diagnostics.result: reproduced two InnoDB transaction deadlocks (1213, SQLSTATE 40001); no lock timeout in this diagnostic

compaction_control.scope: Separate diagnostic after PostgreSQL; preserves the original qualified matrix. No retroactive selection or replacement samples.

checkpoint_context.note: Periodic status covers the whole phase, not exact sysbench windows. Publication transitions are bracketed by status observations; they are not individual checkpoint durations.

engine_metadata.contract: FLUSH/FUA durable on local disk; S3 checkpoint asynchronous every 5 seconds, longer during backlog

limitations: Earlier reference and later control use an evolving fixture; temporal-order bias remains.
Process I/O snapshots bracket sysbench including setup/exit.
Peak RSS is a process-lifetime high water, not a sample-only maximum.
preconditioning_limitations: The reference read_write/write_only samples followed three read_only measurements; this predeclared control measures only read_write/write_only after the same 60-second MySQL warmup.
The fixture evolves between the earlier reference and this later control; prior writes, binlog expiration and operating-system caches are not reset.
Only the engine-option delta is strictly isolated. This one-pass diagnostic does not establish causality independently of workload history and temporal order.

protocol.read: Same immutable seeded data; 4096 random 4 KiB reads QD32, then 256 MiB sequential 1 MiB reads QD16. Fresh local cache before each workload; checksum on every read.
protocol.write: Both compact_checkpoints=true and false, with segment sizes 8/16/32/64 MiB. Fresh volume for each sample; 256 MiB sequential 128 KiB writes + CRC verification, then 4096 random 4 KiB writes with fsync in a disjoint zone. Count through clean drain, then verify the 256 MiB dataset from S3 with a new local directory.
protocol.order: One shared seed. Balanced read orders: 16/64/256, 64/256/16, 256/16/64. Rotated segment orders, alternating compaction order per round, three rounds.
protocol.cache: 64 MiB RAM, 128 MiB SSD, 64 MiB hot WAL; Linux/provider caches not purged. Process restart empties RAM; cold adopt creates a new local directory.
protocol.contract: Local fsync, S3 asynchronous, 5 second checkpoint cadence; final drain included in write cost.
protocol.limits: Instrumented sequential diagnostics on shared VM, not a production forecast. Proxy changes timings. Read range tested separately from the segment-size/compaction matrix. Logical pages remain 4 KiB. Compact output is grouped per 4096-page index shard, so WAL segment size does not directly size compact S3 objects. Read-only adoption can update ownership metadata but does not change the seeded user data. No new crash-safety claim for each tuning value.
